propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran month-end close rehearsals for the reporting system in the pre-production environment for five cycles and logged every deviation.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the runbook timing log document the rehearsals and the environment.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the close runbook and the service dashboard prototype and drafted the production support rota and escalation procedure.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the runbook, dashboard and rota draft.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the financial reporting system in production through month-end closes and handled production incidents.
propositions.rationale: The resume places every close in the pre-production environment and production incidents with the incumbent supplier's service manager; the candidate's screen remark about production describes the system's status, not his own operation of it.

expectedGap: The materials document rehearsal closes in pre-production; they do not document a production close run by the candidate or production incident handling.
expectedBoundaryNote: Preserve the environment the resume names: pre-production rehearsals, with the live service and its incidents handled by the incumbent supplier.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate ran any close after cut-over, who held the pager during production incidents, and for which cycles.
